description: Makes a design move with Paletoo’s motion presets: everything enters in reading order (the headline rises, details follow, the picture scales in) and one small accent keeps moving; the energy (subtle, balanced, bold) follows the design’s mood unless the person says it. Whole design or one artboard; works with the design closed too (saved, ready to play). Use it for «make it move», «an animated post for Reels». `export: «mp4»` (webm, gif, lottie) also returns the file when the design is open. Example: { design, artboard: «<story id>», export: «mp4» }.

artboard.description: one artboard’s id (get_design); none: every artboard of the design’s page

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

energy.description: say it only when the person did

export.description: also make the file (made in the person’s open editor: the design must be open in Paletoo)

loop.description: false: nothing keeps moving after the entrance (default: one accent loops)

mood.description: the mood in the person’s words («calm and premium», «loud sale»); none: read from the design

preset.description: older name for the energy (typewriter: balanced, the headline typed in)

seconds.description: how long the video is (default: the entrance and one turn of the loop)

name: animate_design
title: Animate
